notes.title: Major Update Plans!
notes.notes:
Hello Date Banger Players! 


🎉 THANK YOU FOR 20,000+ PLAYERS! 🎉


Since launching version 1.0, we've welcomed countless new players into our community! Based on your amazing reviews and feedback in our Discord channel, we can see that Date Banger has truly resonated with you all. However, we've also received incredible suggestions and requests to make the game even better.



After carefully reviewing all your feedback, we've decided to roll out these improvements through SEPARATE MAJOR UPDATE WAVES Please keep in mind that these are substantial updates that will take time for our dedicated three-person team to complete!



🏆 Date Banger's Achievements!

Before we dive into the updates, let's celebrate Date Banger's incredible milestones:
- #4 in Popular New Releases on Steam's Front Page!- #2 in Adult Content New & Popular!- #3 in Adult Content Top Sellers!- #178 in Overall Top Sellers!



🚀 Planned Major Updates

Here's what's coming to Date Banger soon:



 🎮 Girl Date Games

Challenge the ladies at their favorite games! Think you can impress them by beating their high scores? Now you'll need to outperform the girls at the games they love most. Plus, competing against other players' high scores will unlock exciting new rewards and entertainment!



👤 Player Model with Customization

Your 3D model is coming! Soon you'll have a customizable player model that better represents you, complete with skin tone options and wardrobe choices!



 👗 Girl Clothing Shop

Dress up your waifu in style! Want to buy new outfits for your lady? We're adding fresh clothing styles and color options for every girl!



 💕 Foreplay Activities

Set the mood before the main event! Looking to spice things up and build excitement? Interactive foreplay activities are coming soon, letting you properly prepare your partner for what's ahead!



 👩 New Girl

Who could say no to a new waifu? We've already started working and planning for this exciting addition. For now, it's staying a surprise!



🔧 UX Improvements

Smoother gameplay experience! We're addressing various user experience elements that, while not bugs, could definitely be improved for better overall gameplay!



🏅 Achievements

We want achievements to be fun! That's why we waited until the game was more complete. Now we're ready to add them to enhance your gaming experience!





 What's Next?

Once these updates are complete, we'll continue working on even more exciting content! Remember, We are reading all of the suggestions and we are deciding what is going to be fit in the game more!
This update wave is just one of the upcoming waves!




Join our Discord community to be part of the Date Banger family and stay updated on all the latest developments!




---



Thank you for your continued support and feedback - you make Date Banger better every day!

notes.title: 0.3.5 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
🔥 0.3.5 MAJOR UPDATE IS HERE! 🔥

🚨 WARNING: Starting a new game is strongly recommended! 🚨  
This update brings so much awesomeness that older saves won’t take full advantage of it. Don't miss out!

---

💞 What’s New in Date Banger? 💞


Revamped Game Loop: We’ve reimagined how you play! Get ready for a smoother, more immersive experience.  

📞 Phone Call Dialogue System: Now, when women give you their numbers, it’s your job to chat, charm, and eventually invite them home. Learn what they like and impress them with your conversation skills. Choose wisely—your words matter!  

🎁 Gift-Giving System: Women LOVE attention and gifts! It’s time to figure out the perfect present (and its color!) to win them over. Choose the right combo, and watch them fall for you! 💘  

💖 Profile Pages Redesigned: Track your relationships in style! Visit women’s profiles to see where you stand and plan your next move. Who deserves your attention? Now you’ll know.  

Flapd-ck Hitbox Fixes: Minigame adjustments! Better hitboxes, more rewards. Cha-ching! 💸  

Comment System Updates: Want to leave a comment? You’ll need to like her profile first. Plus, we’ve added more spicy comments for every woman. 😉  

Lower Like Costs: Likes on the app are now more affordable, so swipe away without worries!  


---

✨ What’s Coming Next? ✨

🚀 **Translation Fixes:** Thanks to our first Steam payout, we’ll address language issues across the game.  

👩‍🎨 **Character Overhaul:** Every woman in the game is getting a rework—new anatomy, animations, and unique traits. Once done, we’ll add NEW women to the mix!  

🏠 **House System Redesign:** Say goodbye to multiple houses. Welcome to ONE BIG HOUSE where you can move around, greet women at the door, and walk them to activity spots. No more “she doesn’t like your house” drama!  

🎥 **Date-Tok Animation Boost:** More animations are coming, but first, we’re reworking all the characters. Bear with us!  

🎲 **New Activities and Minigames:** Get ready for exciting dates and fun!  

🌎 **Outdoor Dates:** Plan romantic encounters outside. What’s more charming than that?

---

📣 We Hear You! 📣

Over the past month, we’ve been listening to your feedback on Discord and Steam. From feature requests to bug reports, we’ve taken it all into account. Your insights are shaping the future of Date Banger, and we can’t wait to share more with you.  

Let’s make this game something truly special—together! 💕 Join the conversation and keep those suggestions coming!
